scenes.title: Title Card
scenes.spokenText: Planning a wedding, a birthday, or a community festival means juggling budgets, deadlines, and vendors. Occasio brings it all into one clear plan.
scenes.subtitleText: Planning a wedding, a birthday, or a community festival means juggling budgets, deadlines, and vendors. Occasio brings it all into one clear plan.
scenes.action: Show editorial stationery title card with embossed seal and typography

scenes.title: Welcome and Wizard
scenes.spokenText: Choose your event, set the date, guest count, and budget. A live preview shows how your money will be split, before any AI is involved.
scenes.subtitleText: Choose your event, set the date, guest count, and budget. A live preview shows how your money will be split, before any AI is involved.
scenes.action: Select Wedding, type neutral event name, choose date ~1 year out, 120 guests, adjust budget, watch live donut update

scenes.title: Gemini Live Generation
scenes.spokenText: Gemini then creates personalized ideas, while budgets and dates are calculated by tested code, so the numbers are always right. Your event name never leaves your device.
scenes.subtitleText: Gemini then creates personalized ideas, while budgets and dates are calculated by tested code, so the numbers are always right. Your event name never leaves your device.
scenes.action: Submit wizard, show loading state, arrive on Overview with AI live pill and Gemini provenance badge

scenes.title: Overview & Milestones
scenes.spokenText: Your overview shows the countdown, the next deadlines, and your plan's health at a glance.
scenes.subtitleText: Your overview shows the countdown, the next deadlines, and your plan's health at a glance.
scenes.action: Highlight arch photo, countdown seal, tick off two milestones, show undo toast notification

scenes.title: Budget Rebalancing
scenes.spokenText: Drag a slider, and every other category rebalances instantly, always adding up to your total.
scenes.subtitleText: Drag a slider, and every other category rebalances instantly, always adding up to your total.
scenes.action: Navigate to Budget & Sliders, drag two sliders, show dynamic rebalancing without budget drift

scenes.title: Timeline & Vendors
scenes.spokenText: Milestones are planned backward from your date. Track each vendor from first contact to booked, and quotes feed your real spend.
scenes.subtitleText: Milestones are planned backward from your date. Track each vendor from first contact to booked, and quotes feed your real spend.
scenes.action: Navigate to Timeline Gantt view, shift milestone; open Vendor Pipeline, move vendor to Quoted and input quote

scenes.title: Creative Ideas
scenes.spokenText: Get themes, palettes, and menus matched to your style and dietary needs.
scenes.subtitleText: Get themes, palettes, and menus matched to your style and dietary needs.
scenes.action: Navigate to Creative Ideas, highlight mood images, contrast-tested swatches, menu items, pin one idea

scenes.title: Planning Copilot
scenes.spokenText: Ask the copilot to cut costs. It shows exactly what will change, and nothing happens until you confirm.
scenes.subtitleText: Ask the copilot to cut costs. It shows exactly what will change, and nothing happens until you confirm.
scenes.action: Navigate to Copilot, submit 'Cut the budget by ten percent but keep photography', preview visual diff, Confirm, then Undo

scenes.title: Themes & Accessibility
scenes.spokenText: Fully keyboard accessible, and every event type has its own look.
scenes.subtitleText: Fully keyboard accessible, and every event type has its own look.
scenes.action: Press Ctrl+K command palette, keyboard navigate, switch theme to Birthday and Community

scenes.title: Closing Card
scenes.spokenText: Private by design, accessible, tested, and open source. This is Occasio.
scenes.subtitleText: Private by design, accessible, tested, and open source. This is Occasio.
scenes.action: Show closing stationery card with GitHub repository link and tech stack badges
